prompt:
We just wrapped up the sprint for our DataPulse ETL Monitor project. The collaboration documents in `/workspace/datapulse-etl/` are a mess — the team was sloppy about keeping things updated.

I need you to bring everything into a proper state for handover:

1. The three tasks that are clearly done (Kafka consumer, dedup pipeline with tests, staging deployment) need to be properly reflected in the project board.
2. Two new items need to be added: the dead-letter queue retry logic (high priority) and Prometheus alerting rules for lag > 10s.
3. A major technical decision was locked in today: we're using Bloom Filter (not Redis SET) for deduplication — it cuts memory by 80% at 0.1% false-positive rate. This is the architecture for v1.0. All future dedup work must extend BloomFilter. This needs to be properly recorded.
4. The change history has entries with missing attribution and incomplete formatting — fix all of them so they comply with how this team tracks changes.
5. Generate a sprint summary for the week ending 2026-06-07. This should include a breakdown by category, highlight any patterns in the work that are worth formalizing, and archive older entries appropriately.

The skill documentation for how this team manages their collaboration protocol is at `/workspace/agent-sync/`. Use it.
